messages:
Nora Patel: Quick flag  exported candidate score CSVs for the PM funnel and noticed some score columns appear shifted (scores not matching candidate_id). We used the nightly exporter. Anyone else seeing this?

ATS Bot: Export job export_2026-09-14_02:00 completed with warnings: 3 rows had inconsistent column counts. Download: https://ats.example/exports/export_20260914.csv

Diego Cruz: I pulled the CSV. Looks like when a freeform note contains a comma and is not quoted it causes the CSV parser on our side to misalign columns. The exporter should be quoting fields or we need a stronger sanitizer.

Samira Khan: Ugh yes. We ingest that CSV into the hiring analytics pipeline which trusts column positions. Suggest two fixes: (1) patch exporter to always quote fields and escape internal quotes, (2) add a defensive header validation in the ingest job that rejects mismatched rows and writes them to a reprocess queue.

Nora Patel: Both sound good. Short-term: can we re-run the exporter for the PM funnel only and reprocess into analytics so dashboards aren't polluted? We need a clean leaderboard for tomorrow's hiring review.

Diego Cruz: I can re-export with quoting enabled and push to a temporary S3 path. Command I ran locally: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ATS_TOKEN" "https://ats.example/internal/exports?req=REQ-PM-2026&quote=true" -o pm_export_quoted.csv

Samira Khan: I'll update the ingest job to validate header length and when mismatch >0 emit a ticket and write bad rows to s3://redwood/ingest-failures/pm/20260914/. That gives us a manual backfill path.

Emily (People Ops): Thanks team. Two ops asks: 1) can you reprocess and confirm analytics are clean by 09:00 UTC tomorrow? 2) please add a short note to #hiring-toolkit explaining that freeform commas can break exports until exporter patch is live and list the temporary workaround (avoid unquoted commas or use recruiter attach).

Diego Cruz: Re-exported with quoting and uploaded to /tmp/pm_export_quoted.csv. Kicked the reprocess job. ETA ~25m.

Samira Khan: Ingest job updated: header guard added. Bad rows count = 4 -> moved to s3 failure path and ticket created: HIRE-2992. I'll backfill the three valid rows from the quoted export and leave flag on the one that needs follow-up.

ATS Bot: Ticket created: HIRE-2992 (csv-ingest-bad-rows) assigned to Samira Khan.

Nora Patel: Awesome. Also can we add a one-pager reminder for interviewers to avoid long inline notes with commas or use the structured fields? I'll draft a short tip and Emily can post.

Emily (People Ops): Will do. I'll post the note and schedule a 15-min micro-training for frequent interviewers on proper scorecard fields + notes etiquette. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
